Retrospective OULAD 2014J reanalysis of the previously reported cohort. Include registrations known by day 0 and still registered at day 0. Exclude test learners observed in any earlier presentation. Use both 2013 presentations for development. Base classifier is L2 logistic regression on enrollment covariates (module, education, age band, previous attempts, credit load, registration day). Use five learner-ID-modulo folds and out-of-fold correctness for fitting L2 logistic selectors. No tuning or additional calibration. Refit base on all development rows. Both selectors use max probability and top-two margin. Augment only the proposed selector with enrollment covariates. Compare maximum probability and negative entropy as fixed rankings. Select floor(70% of each course) independently, stable source-order ties. Report maximum course error, pooled error, per-course counts and paired percentile intervals for worst-risk differences using 2000 learner-cluster bootstrap draws conditional on frozen decisions (seed 42). Higher scores favor acceptance. No substantive win unless both primary contrasts exclude zero favorably.
